settings.ai.mode.title: AI Mode
settings.ai.mode.howTo: online = real provider APIs; local = on-device MediaPipe model; deterministic = offline rules engine (no ML, always works, no network). Chat and AI features fall back to deterministic when a provider or model is unavailable.

settings.ai.provider.title: AI Provider
settings.ai.provider.howTo: Which configured provider preset the online mode calls first. Each preset carries its own base URL and model id; per-provider keys are stored in the Android Keystore-backed preferences.

troubleshooting.cause: Missing or expired key for this provider
troubleshooting.fix: Settings → AI → API key for the selected provider; the next call re-authenticates.

settings.ai.api_key.title: API Key
settings.ai.api_key.howTo: Secret for the active provider. Stored encrypted (EncryptedSharedPreferences); never written to logs or exports. Leave blank to use the per-provider key slot.

settings.ml.temperature.title: Sampling Temperature
settings.ml.temperature.howTo: 0.0 = deterministic/conservative replies, 2.0 = maximally creative. Applies to the on-device engine after Apply & Reload (online providers use their server-side defaults).

settings.ml.top_k.title: Top-K Sampling
settings.ml.top_k.howTo: Limits sampling to the K most likely tokens. Lower = safer/more predictable text; higher = wider variety. Applied on engine reload.

settings.ml.max_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
settings.ml.max_tokens.howTo: Hard cap on generated tokens per reply for the local engine. Larger caps take longer and use more memory; 1024 is the balanced default.

settings.ml.telemetry.title: ML Telemetry
settings.ml.telemetry.howTo: Records latency/throughput samples around real inference calls into a session-only ring buffer shown on the ML dashboard. Nothing leaves the device; turning it off stops recording new samples.

settings.general.autostart.title: Autostart
settings.general.autostart.howTo: Start background services (overlord polling, healing loops) automatically on app launch. Off = everything starts only when you tap Start.

settings.overlord.aggression.title: Overlord Aggression
settings.overlord.aggression.howTo: balanced = polite timing between autonomous cycles; aggressive = shorter jitter, more frequent actions; patient = long gaps for stealth. Cycle interval also honours the per-cycle seconds setting.

settings.privacy.clipboard_clear_sec.title: Clipboard Clear TTL
settings.privacy.clipboard_clear_sec.howTo: Seconds after a copy before the clipboard is wiped (0 = never). Protects secrets copied into the clipboard from the loot/vault screens.

settings.updates.hotfix_channel.title: Content Hot-Fix Channel
settings.updates.hotfix_channel.howTo: Base URL of a signed content channel for tooltip/kill-switch hot-fixes. Blank = disabled and only the shipped assets are used. Content from the channel is signature-checked before it replaces anything.

settings.c2.mode.title: C2 Destination
settings.c2.mode.howTo: Self-Host runs the embedded NanoHTTPD C2 server on-device and serves QUANTUMDASH at /dash. Remote-Connect points the native dashboard at an externally-hosted C2 endpoint; the web panel at <host>/dash is opened in a browser alongside the native controls.

settings.c2.remote_host.title: Remote C2 Host
settings.c2.remote_host.howTo: Base URL of the externally-hosted C2 server (e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8443). The native dashboard controls work regardless of mode; only dashboard indicators and the web-panel link target this host.

settings.c2.destination_gate_shown.title: C2 Destination Gate Shown
settings.c2.destination_gate_shown.howTo: Tracks whether the first-launch C2 destination gate has been dismissed. When false, the gate splash will appear on next launch; when true it is skipped so the dashboard opens directly.
